title: Move field @Autowired to constructor injection
summary: An OrderService that no test can hand a mock to, until it takes its dependencies in the constructor.

turns.user: trying to unit test OrderService and I cant get a mock in there. do I really have to boot spring for this

assistant.body: You do not. The field @Autowired is the problem: Spring writes into the private fields by reflection, so a test that calls new has no way in. Let us switch to constructor injection. The fields become final, which guarantees nobody can build an instance with a dependency missing.

turns.user: works. wait no @Autowired on the constructor? also lint says the import is unused

assistant.body: Correct, none needed. Since Spring 4.3 a class with a single constructor gets it used for injection automatically, and Boot 3 sits on Spring 6. Removing the import that nothing uses now.
